args.sql:
CREATE TABLE high_risk_transactions (
    alert_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    risk_registry VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    alert_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    json_details JSONB NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO high_risk_transactions (risk_registry, alert_type, severity, json_details)
SELECT
    ra.riskregistry,
    'Money Laundering',
    'High',
    jsonb_build_object(
        'transaction_id', t.txregistry,
        'payment_method', t.paymethod,
        'payment_amount', t.payamtusd,
        'buyer_risk_rate', b.buyriskrate,
        'vendor_risk_rate', v.vendrate,
        'market_risk_score', m.market_status_reputation->>'reputation_score'
    )
FROM
    riskanalysis ra
JOIN
    transactions t ON ra.txref = t.txregistry
JOIN
    buyers b ON t.buyref = b.buyregistry
JOIN
    vendors v ON t.vendref = v.vendregistry
JOIN
    markets m ON t.mktref = m.mktregistry
WHERE
    ra.moneyrisk = 'High';

        'buyer_risk_rate', b.buyriskrate,
        'vendor_risk_rate', v.vendrate,
        'market_risk_score', m.market_status_reputation->>'reputation_score'
    )
FROM
    riskanalysis ra
JOIN
    transactions t ON ra.txref = t.txregistry
JOIN
    buyers b ON t.buyref = b.buyregistry
JOIN
    products p ON t.prodref = p.prodregistry
JOIN
    vendors v ON p.vendref = v.vendregistry
JOIN
    markets m ON t.mktref = m.mktregistry
WHERE
    ra.moneyrisk = 'High';
